name: Patreon Page

sources.title: Patreon homepage — 'Get Started' leads to /create; 'Starting a Patreon is free'

conditions: Starting a Patreon creator page is free — Patreon monetizes via a platform fee on earnings, not an upfront listing fee
The signup URL in the batch (/signup) returned 403 to the fetcher; the live entry point is https://www.patreon.com/create ('Get Started')
requirements: A creator/community angle — Patreon is a membership/community monetization platform, not a product directory; a SaaS 'listing' means launching a creator page (updates, community, perks)
Content must comply with Patreon's community guidelines and content policies
Payout details (bank/payment) required only when monetizing
preparation: Creator page name, profile and cover images, and a clear 'what patrons get' pitch
Decide free vs paid membership tiers (membership, digital products shop) — a free-membership-only page is a valid zero-cost presence
Website/social links to include on the public page
workflow: Go to https://www.patreon.com/create and sign up / log in
Set up the creator page: name, visuals, about text, tiers or free membership
Launch/publish the page — it becomes public at patreon.com/<handle>
Post an initial public post so the page isn't empty
watchFor: Patreon is discoverable mostly to existing fans — a page with no content has little SEO/listing value on its own
Platform fees apply on earnings (not on page creation)
countsAsLive: A public creator page at patreon.com/<handle> loads without login and shows the launched page with at least one post/tier
unknowns: Whether public Patreon pages pass link equity to the creator's website link
Review/verification steps, if any, before a new page is publicly listed in 'Find a Creator'
